content:
name: EOS 0.8 Program Adoption v2

on:
  push:
    branches: [eos/v0.8-program-adoption]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/eos-v08-program-adoption-v2.yml'
      - '.eos/adoptions/**'
      - 'engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0001.md'
      - 'scripts/upgrade-eos-0.8.py'
      - 'scripts/test-eos-0.8-program-adoption.py'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  upgrade-and-adopt:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Converge EOS implementation and schemas to 0.8
        run: |
          python3 scripts/upgrade-eos-0.8.py --apply
          python3 scripts/upgrade-eos-0.8.py --apply
          python3 scripts/upgrade-eos-0.8.py

      - name: Adopt accepted MVP execution horizon
        run: >-
          ./scripts/eos adopt .eos/adoptions/mvp-foundation.json --apply
          --by "Project Authority"
          --reason "Adopt the accepted Foundation Stabilization MVP execution horizon."

      - name: Run EOS 0.8 regression contract
        run: python3 scripts/test-eos-0.8-program-adoption.py

      - name: Verify EOS strictly
        run: ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Synchronize machine documents
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py

      - name: Commit deterministic migration outputs
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No migration changes to commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git commit -m "feat(eos): adopt stabilized MVP program under EOS 0.8"
          git push origin HEAD:eos/v0.8-program-adoption
